result.topic_en: Gauss describes the root-squaring (Graeffe-type) method for algebraic equations: recursive formulas producing derived equations whose coefficients are power sums of squared roots, plus two auxiliary systems for the case of roots of equal modulus.
result.transcription:
[?]Gauss[?] Math. 20 [-45b-] 1
Ursprüngliche Gleichung $x^\mu - Px^{\mu-1} + Qx^{\mu-2} - Rx^{\mu-3} + Sx^{\mu-4} - Tx^{\mu-5} + \text{etc.} = 0$
Für die abgeleiteten Gleichungen treten $P', P'', P'''\ldots$ an die Stelle von $P$; $Q', Q'', Q'''\ldots$ an die Stelle von $Q$ u.s.w., nach folgenden Formeln
$P' = PP - 2Q$, $Q' = QQ - 2PR + 2S$, $R' = RR - 2QS + 2PT - 2U$, u.s.f.
$P'' = P'P' - 2Q'$, $Q'' = Q'Q' - 2P'R' + 2S'$, $R'' = R'R' - 2Q'S' + 2P'T' - 2U'$ u.s.f.
u.s.w.
Dies reicht aus, wenn die Gleichung keine imaginare Wurzeln {+hat+}, [-oder-] vielmehr, wenn die Moduln aller Wurzeln ungleich sind. Sonst muss man noch ein neues System von Grössen $p, q, r, s, t, u \ldots$ bilden, was auf zwei verschiedene Arten geschehen kann
Erste Art
$p = \mu$, $q = (\mu-1)P$, $r = (\mu-2)Q$, $s = (\mu-3)R$, $t = (\mu-4)S$, $u = (\mu-5)T$ u.s.f.
$p' = pP - q$, $q' = qQ \begin{smallmatrix}-rP\\-pR\end{smallmatrix} + s$, $r' = rR \begin{smallmatrix}-sQ & +tP\\-qS & +pT\end{smallmatrix} - u$ u.s.w.
$p'' = p'P' - q'$, $q'' = q'Q' \begin{smallmatrix}-r'P'\\-p'R'\end{smallmatrix} + s'$, $r'' = r'R' \begin{smallmatrix}-s'Q' & +t'P'\\-q'S' & +pT'\end{smallmatrix} - u'$ u.s.w.
Hier wird $P^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n}$, $Q^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n}b^{2^n}$, $R^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n}b^{2^n}c^{2^n}$ u.s.w.
$p^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n-1}$, $q^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n-1}b^{2^n}$, $r^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n-1}b^{2^n}c^{2^n}$ u.s.w.
Zweite Art
$p = PP - 2Q$, $q = PQ - 3R$, $r = PR - 4S$, $s = PS - 5T$ u.s.w.
Die andern eben so wie vorher, nemlich
$p' = pP - q$, $q' = qQ \begin{smallmatrix}-rP\\-pR\end{smallmatrix} + s$, $r' = rR \begin{smallmatrix}-sQ & +tP\\-qS & +pT\end{smallmatrix} - u$ u.s.w.
$p'' = p'P' - q'$, $q'' = q'Q' \begin{smallmatrix}-r'P'\\-p'R'\end{smallmatrix} + s'$, $r'' = r'R' \begin{smallmatrix}-s'Q' & +t'P'\\-q'S' & +p'T'\end{smallmatrix} - u'$ u.s.w.
Hier wird $p^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n+1}$, $q^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n+1}b^{2^n}$, $r^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n+1}b^{2^n}c^{2^n}$ u.s.w.

methods.what: Root-squaring (Graeffe/Dandelin) recursion producing the coefficients of an equation whose roots are the squares of the original roots
Iteration of the root-squaring step to obtain successive derived equations
After n squarings the coefficients are elementary symmetric functions of the 2^n-th powers of the roots
methods.quote: Hier wird $P^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n}$, $Q^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n}b^{2^n}$, $R^{(n)} = \Sigma a^{2^n}b^{2^n}c^{2^n}$ u.s.w.

methods.what: First auxiliary system, initialised from the coefficients weighted by mu, mu-1, ..., and updated alongside the squaring; it yields sums with one root raised to 2^n-1
Update rule for the auxiliary system
methods.quote: $p' = pP - q$, $q' = qQ \begin{smallmatrix}-rP\\-pR\end{smallmatrix} + s$, $r' = rR \begin{smallmatrix}-sQ & +tP\\-qS & +pT\end{smallmatrix} - u$ u.s.w.

methods.what: Interpretation of the first auxiliary system after n steps
Second auxiliary system: alternative initialisation using the same update rule; it yields sums with one root raised to 2^n+1
Interpretation of the second auxiliary system after n steps

items.quote: Dies reicht aus, wenn die Gleichung keine imaginare Wurzeln {+hat+}, [-oder-] vielmehr, wenn die Moduln aller Wurzeln ungleich sind. Sonst muss man noch ein neues System von Grössen $p, q, r, s, t, u \ldots$ bilden, was auf zwei verschiedene Arten geschehen kann
items.english: This suffices if the equation has no imaginary roots, or rather, if the moduli of all the roots are unequal. Otherwise one must also form a new system of quantities p, q, r, s, t, u ..., which can be done in two different ways.
